description: Welcome to NORA Research Lab! We use machine learning & AI to rethink mineral exploration - smarter, faster, and more sustainable. I'm building a curious, supportive team where everyone learns, shares ideas, and grows together. I bring passion for geology, data & teamwork. Looking for teammates in geology, GIS, Python, ML, or visualization. No expert needed. Just bring a curious mind and willingness to learn. Join us now and let's discover what's hidden beneath together! Let's go! Yes
